name: animoria
description: Ultra-fast cross-IDE asset intelligence, motion analytics, and automated deduplication engine
author: Sxnnyside

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.package:native-daemon: cargo build --release --manifest-path packages/animoria-core-rust/Cargo.toml && node scripts/copy-native-daemon.mjs && node scripts/verify-packaged-daemon.mjs
scripts.package:jetbrains: pnpm --filter @animoria/ui build && pnpm package:native-daemon && cd packages/animoria-jetbrains && ./gradlew buildPlugin
